Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL3885882. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL3885882, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
